_comment: 验收场景 3：余额不足——HalfDebitResidue 出现并可回滚；用户可用不出现静默缺口。
_scenario: 用户余额 50 USDT，tick 需 100 USDT；账本返回余额不足错误；RecordInsufficientResidue 产生 HalfDebitResidue(state=open)；回滚后 state=rolled_back；无静默可用缺口。

rollback_step.reason: ledger entry not created, no rollback needed

invariants: residue can be closed (hung when no ledger entry)
user available balance unchanged (no silent debit)
open residue prevents new CatchUpWindow for same plan
